description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v0.10.0 (BREAKING — tool-surface compression; the last 0.x minor): 20 portfolio tools fold into 5 action-routed dispatchers — ls_account / ls_watchlist / ls_watched_themes / ls_portfolio_io / ls_holding (each takes an `action` argument). New LS_TOOL_PROFILE env var: `standard` (default) hides the 3 catalog tools, `all` exposes them. Surface 48 → 32 in the standard profile (35 in all). Additive: ls_get_stock_info gains an opt-in `foreign` section (t1716 foreign-ownership level); list/screener tools unify their row cap to `limit` and emit `total_available`; ls_get_index_history gains output_mode=export with a dataset_id drill. See the Migration section in https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md.
